title: sajorium corniculatum
intro: Sajorium corniculatum, commonly known as Indian snakeroot, is a plant species that belongs to the family Apiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which can help alleviate conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its analgesic, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties. The health benefits of Sajorium corniculatum include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and provide antioxidant protection.
